scope: Display confirmation and cancellation lifetimes, using the existing native transaction guardian.
changes: Keep and Revert callbacks retain the rendered transaction and panel lifetime instead of resolving the latest transaction at delivery.
Countdown updates preserve current confirmation controls; replaced, closed, busy or retired confirmations cannot dispatch.
Closing an Apply retires its admission even if the panel reopens before its result arrives.
Internal rollback retains exact transaction identity and remains valid before the confirmation snapshot.

coverage: Captured confirmation callbacks across replacement, terminal phases, countdown and panel lifetime.
Close/Toggle then reopen before Apply completion, rejected admission and stale success during a new request.
Root panel dismissal with known and late admissions, including reopening before completion.
